summary: A Telegram trading channel promoted fake cryptocurrency arbitrage opportunities using fraudulent trading platforms that initially allowed small profitable withdrawals before freezing funds and demanding an AML KYC payment to unlock withdrawals. The channel operator continued encouraging the victim to pay the additional fee despite the withdrawal being blocked.
user_mistake: Trusted a social media trading channel promoting unrealistic arbitrage profits
prevention: Ignore arbitrage opportunities promoted through social media / Refuse payments requested to unlock frozen cryptocurrency withdrawals
